title: Database isolation anomaly
description:
Explain how two concurrent transactions can both observe no reservation and overbook. Name write skew, choose serializable isolation or a locking/constraint strategy, and discuss retrying conflicts.

Write a structured explanation. This is a transparent keyword rubric, not an AI architect or proof of a sound design. Check every tradeoff yourself; a rubric pass demonstrates coverage only.

reference.text:
Explain how two concurrent transactions can both observe no reservation and overbook. Name write skew, choose serializable isolation or a locking/constraint strategy, and discuss retrying conflicts.
Snapshot isolation prevents many lost updates but can permit write skew across different rows. An invariant needs a coordination boundary, not merely transactions.
